Assemble complete message Bounded framing / staging
Wait without send authority No upstream socket / no grant
Freeze exact semantic operation Message / actor / stream / peer
Prepare current child operation Split parent escrow / hold credits
Message policy / original consume Complete error-free Cedar checks
Commit exact queue eligibility Source / history / budget / audit
Bounded physical queue Committed ID / immutable data
Claim this message once Typed handle / one ordered writer
Commit bounded offer intent CAS against active stream epoch
Constrained range submission Exact bytes / peer / deadline
Record offered / partial / unknown Never replay an ambiguous prefix

Retire delegated submission rights Memory release and cost settlement differ

path.aria-label: Memory release and cost settlement differ

g.title: Held / settled / unknown accounting Spent claims remain terminal

One semantic message slot and one application writer per stream; other producers stage inert data. Pre-cut range authority can outlive a seal observation. Unknown prefixes and costs never recreate send rights or free capacity.

path.aria-label: One semantic message slot and one application writer per stream; other producers stage inert data. Pre-cut range authority can outlive a seal observation. Unknown prefixes and costs never recreate send rights or free capacity.
ORIGINAL SEMANTICS / CURRENT AUTHORITY / GUARDED EXECUTION
